note: World modes. The player picks one when creating a world and may switch at any time from the pause menu (not during a guardian fight or a fire defence). Every rule can also be toggled individually in 'Fine tuning' (options). See docs/01_GDD.md §6.

summary.ru: Без врагов и без смерти. Море, туман, стройка.
summary.en: No enemies and no death. Sea, fog and building.

summary.ru: Звери, шторма и холод. Смерть без потерь: просыпаешься дома со всеми вещами.
summary.en: Animals, storms and cold. Death without loss: you wake up at home with all your things.

summary.ru: Туманные твари, стражи маяков и бой как в Valheim. После смерти вещи ждут у кресток-знака.
summary.en: Fog creatures, beacon guardians and Valheim-style combat. After death your things wait at a grave marker.

storms.capsize: a hull below the storm level capsizes; the boat floats and can be righted

death.none: no health loss in Quiet; falling or drowning returns you to the last pier with everything
death.respawn_keep: wake up in bed with all items, short Weary debuff
death.grave: items stay in a grave marker at the death spot; walk back to collect them

cold.mild: no stamina regen in the cold without a coat or fire
cold.full: cold slowly drains health without a coat or fire

beacon.trial: a non-combat trial lights the beacon
beacon.guardian_or_defense: guardian beacons need the guardian beaten; others need the fire defended while it kindles

night_raids.true: on dense-fog nights mistlings probe the homestead edge; lamps and fences keep them out; they never damage walls or stations
